_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Price coiled (flat 30d, neutral funding/momentum) with mini-top factors diverging and no joint breaker; base rate favors HOLD inside the coil.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Hope; narrative silent on forward phase but ratio fade does not contradict caution/coil
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, fear_greed ~55-70, no joint rise in funding + 30d momentum + ETF flows
next_move.invalidated_if: funding and btc_momentum_30d rise together with positive etf_flows (up Optimism), or extreme netflow + fear_greed <55 with negative momentum (down Disbelief)
